question: Where’s the nearest hotel that lies north of Red Wolf Sanctuary, Rising Sun, IN?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois AS P WHERE P.tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_Y(ST_Centroid(P.geometry)) > ST_Y(ST_Centroid(( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Red Wolf Sanctuary%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Rising Sun%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IN%' LIMIT 1 ))) ORDER BY P.geometry <-> ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Red Wolf Sanctuary%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Rising Sun%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IN%' LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1;
